indirect_callers.candidates: Session-owned uploaded IDs not in keptIds; Set owned deduplicates, existing selected media are never owned
indirect_callers.transaction: No encompassing transaction in DraftMediaSession; each injected helper call opens its own rw PRODUCTION_TABLES transaction
indirect_callers.ordering: Upload first persists media; discardExcept awaits cleanup then drops ownership. save discards unkept uploads BEFORE persist(), releases kept ownership only after persist succeeds. cancel closes ownership, waits pending work via allSettled, then discardExcept([]). Failed cleanup leaves ID owned for retry. Preserve scalar public helper and do not imply save/cancel all uploads share one rollback transaction.
